name: Light's Warmth: Dry Stumps can be looted and tossed into the watchtower bonfire (#8071)
contract: Report #8071: on Light's Warmth (175056) the wooden logs in the destroyed Snowsong Valley watchtower cannot be picked up.
The Dry Stump chest 2300667 drops the quest-only Dry Stump 559882, so the quest must list it as a quest item drop for its holder to see it in the loot.
Throw Dry Stump (365037, the item's spell) at a Watchtower Bonfire 2300668 credits the second objective, Logs tossed into the fire.
